#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <numeric>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() : pos(0), size(0) {
        is = &cin;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    istream* is;
    char buf[1024];
    int pos;
    int size;

    int read() {
        if (size == -1)
            throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            is->read(buf, 1024);
            size = is->gcount();
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (n > m) {
            swap(n, m);
        }

        long long V = (long long)n * m;

        if (V < 100) {
            vector<vector<int>> g(V);
            for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < V; ++j) {
                    int r1 = i / m;
                    int c1 = i % m;
                    int r2 = j / m;
                    int c2 = j % m;
                    if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                        g[i].push_back(j);
                    }
                }
            }

            int res = maxMatching(g) * 2;
            out << res << endl;
        } else {
            long long res;
            if (n == 1) {
                res = m / 6 * 6;
                if (m % 6 == 4) res += 2;
                if (m % 6 == 5) res += 4;
            } else {
                res = (long long)n * m;
                res -= res % 2;
            }
            out << res << endl;
        }
    }

    static int maxMatching(vector<vector<int>>& graph) {
        int n = graph.size();
        vector<int> match(n, -1);
        vector<int> p(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (match[i] == -1) {
                int v = findPath(graph, match, p, i);
                while (v != -1) {
                    int pv = p[v];
                    int ppv = match[pv];
                    match[v] = pv;
                    match[pv] = v;
                    v = ppv;
                }
            }
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int x : match) if (x != -1) cnt++;
        return cnt / 2;
    }

    static int findPath(vector<vector<int>>& graph, vector<int>& match, vector<int>& p, int root) {
        fill(p.begin(), p.end(), -1);
        int n = graph.size();
        vector<int> base(n);
        iota(base.begin(), base.end(), 0);

        vector<bool> used(n, false);
        vector<int> q(n);
        int qt = 0;
        used[root] = true;
        q[qt++] = root;
        for (int qh = 0; qh < qt; ++qh) {
            int u = q[qh];
            for (int v : graph[u]) {
                if (base[u] == base[v] || match[u] == v) continue;
                if (v == root || (match[v] != -1 && p[match[v]] != -1)) {
                    int curbase = lca(match, base, p, u, v);
                    vector<bool> blossom(n, false);
                    markPath(match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, v);
                    markPath(match, base, blossom, p, v, curbase, u);
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                        if (blossom[base[i]]) {
                            base[i] = curbase;
                            if (!used[i]) {
                                used[i] = true;
                                q[qt++] = i;
                            }
                        }
                } else if (p[v] == -1) {
                    p[v] = u;
                    if (match[v] == -1)
                        return v;
                    v = match[v];
                    used[v] = true;
                    q[qt++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static void markPath(vector<int>& match, vector<int>& base, vector<bool>& blossom, vector<int>& p, int u, int curbase, int child) {
        for (; base[u] != curbase; u = p[match[u]]) {
            blossom[base[u]] = blossom[base[match[u]]] = true;
            p[u] = child;
            child = match[u];
        }
    }

    static int lca(vector<int>& match, vector<int>& base, vector<int>& p, int a, int b) {
        vector<bool> used(match.size(), false);
        while (true) {
            a = base[a];
            used[a] = true;
            if (match[a] == -1) break;
            a = p[match[a]];
        }
        while (true) {
            b = base[b];
            if (used[b]) return b;
            b = p[match[b]];
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    ostream& out = cout;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
